description: This file defines the CurrencyData class, which models information about currencies such as code, name, decimal places, symbols, and display labels. It is part of the Fineract project’s monetary data package.

classes.name: CurrencyData
classes.description: A data transfer object representing currency attributes such as code, name, decimal places, symbols, and display label, with constructors and methods for instantiation and display label generation.
